proof_body:
by
  intro x y hx hy
  apply Real.abs_le_sqrt
  have h1 := Real.sq_sqrt hx
  have h2 := Real.sq_sqrt hy
  have h3 := Real.sqrt_nonneg x
  have h4 := Real.sqrt_nonneg y
  rcases le_total x y with h | h
  · have h5 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.2 h)]
    nlinarith
  · have h5 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 h)]
    nlinarith
target_source: ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ y → |Real.sqrt x - Real.sqrt y| ≤ Real.sqrt |x - y|
